mainEntity.name: What factors should an insurance agent consider when choosing an AEO provider?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting an AEO provider, insurance agents should consider several key factors. Look for providers with a proven track record in digital marketing, specifically demonstrating an understanding of AI-driven optimization and the insurance industry. Evaluate their strategic approach, ensuring it aligns with your business goals and includes comprehensive services like technical optimization, content strategy, and ongoing analytics. Transparency in reporting and communication is crucial, as is a clear understanding of pricing models. Request case studies or client testimonials relevant to local businesses or similar niches, and ensure their expertise extends beyond basic SEO to current AI trends.
acceptedAnswer.description: When choosing an AEO provider, insurance agents should look for industry experience, a clear strategic approach, transparency, relevant case studies, and expertise in AI trends.
